incident.title: Preventing Audit-Chain Corruption Under Concurrent Requests
incident.selection: concurrent or storm or lock_is_held or rolls_back

original_failure.observed_in: full-suite run at engineering commit cb4ae79: suite passed, but pytest reported 3 unhandled thread exceptions
original_failure.postgres_error: psycopg.errors.UniqueViolation: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "audit_log_pkey"
original_failure.path: convert_lead -> _write: Blocked -> self._audit(..., 'deny', ...) -> INSERT INTO audit_log

before_fix.note: same tests, pre-fix _audit re-installed by tools/legacy_audit_plugin.py

limitations: Intermittent by nature: the pre-fix failure depends on thread timing, so a pass of the old code in any single run proves nothing; the deterministic pause test is the strong evidence.
Single PostgreSQL instance, one process; no multi-node or failover behaviour is claimed.
No throughput or latency measurement was made; none is claimed.
